scenario_description:
Objective: Complete CR-61's started incoming intake condition check and movement record while the lender crate remains in controlled receiving.
Emerging Need: The crate has been opened and documentation begun, but the intake station rejects the temporary barcode and will not advance to identity verification.
Decision Context: The dock, room, and station impose narrowing same-morning limits; a recorded recovery route can preserve the work without changing object identity or loan terms.
Consequence: A timely, reversible verification step could let the same intake resume with an auditable discrepancy; after the carrier removes the crate, that intake opportunity is gone.

parameter.body: CR-61 was delivered to Conditioned Receiving Room 2 at 09:02 with the shipping seal intact. The driver is scheduled to release the dock at 11:30 unless the receiving team reports a discrepancy before departure.

parameter.content: We opened the crate and started the reference photographs and condition notes. The handheld intake scanner rejected the lender's temporary barcode, and the identity-verification screen will not advance, so the intake team has stopped with the object still in receiving.

parameter.title: CR-61 incoming intake condition check
parameter.description: Incoming condition documentation and movement validation for CR-61; receiving access now ends at 10:45.

parameter.content: Collections Systems has a maintenance gap from 10:05 to 10:25. The current intake record will lock at 10:35, and after that the station will require a new session rather than continuing this one.

parameter.subject: CR-61 dock release completed
parameter.body: The driver collected the sealed CR-61 crate at 10:46 and the dock release is complete. The receiving session closed without identity verification being recorded.

parameters: For MOV-CR61-IN only, if the intake scanner rejects the lender's temporary barcode after condition documentation has begun, Mireya may pause the scanner workflow and coordinate a two-person manual serial verification with Collections Systems through Rowan Ives at rowan.ives@harborcounty.example. The scanner error must be retained with the movement record. This does not authorize changing the object ID, collection ownership, lender information, loan terms, or accepting an unresolved discrepancy.
